verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI exposes message history that developers can serialize/deserialize to continue a conversation across sessions (docs-7, comm-15), and durable execution can preserve run state across restarts (docs-10), but there is no dedicated long-term memory store, semantic recall, or cross-thread memory system documented — persistence is left entirely to the developer to implement manually. Missing for 10: built-in persistent memory store/vector recall, cross-thread memory sharing, and independent evidence of long-term memory working in production beyond simple history serialization.
